    result = reg.as_namedtuple()

    assert result._fields == ("blue", "red")
    assert result.blue == "\x1b[34m"
    assert result.red == "\x1b[31m"

    # An empty register exports an empty namedtuple
    empty_result = Register().as_namedtuple()
    assert empty_result._fields == ()
